This vertical editorial illustration features a large, amber-colored glass bottle with a ribbed silver metal cap, tilted diagonally across the frame. Inside the bottle, a reddish-brown liquid fills the lower half. Emerging from this liquid is a small, five-fingered human hand and forearm, reaching upwards towards the top of the bottle. The hand is depicted with detailed skin folds. The bottle is partially obscured at the bottom left by a light gray diagonal block containing black text. 

At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is printed in large, serif capital letters. Above it are two headlines in black: "Menghapus Jejak Kejahatan Kanjuruhan H.70" and "30 Tahun Indonesian Dance Festival H.62". Below the logo, smaller red letters read "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". The main headline on the gray block reads "OBAT PENCABUT NYAWA" in bold black capital letters. Below it, a paragraph begins with "Badan Pengawas Obat dan Makanan disinyalir lambat..." and ends with "H.32". At the bottom right, a barcode, QR codes, the text "BPOM RI", and publication details for "31 OKTOBER-6 NOVEMBER 2022" are visible.
